content: nix flake check: verifies flake evaluates and BUILDS all checks.<system>.* derivations; evaluation-level checks require listed outputs be derivations INCLUDING nixosConfigurations.*.config.system.build.toplevel (current system only, eval not build). homeConfigurations is NOT auto-checked -> must wire explicit checks: checks.${system}.home-<name> = homeConfigurations.<name>.config.system.build.activationPackage; same for toplevel to actually build NixOS closures. Options: --all-systems, --no-build. Cross-system: aarch64 configs only build when evaluated for that system or via --all-systems; guard per-host system attrs.
